title: Alef: head of an ox, strength, God (1)
summary: Close-up study of the letter alef in light blue: three styles of the modern letter, its name, sound A, value 1, ancient ox-head pictograph and meaning "Head of an Ox, Strength, God", with a row showing the pictograph turning into an older rotated form and then into the Latin letter A.

text.text: Head of an Ox, Strength, God

letters.meaning: Head of an Ox, Strength, God (ox-head pictograph; becomes the Latin letter A)

pictures.description: Small ancient (paleo-Hebrew) pictograph of an ox head with horns, drawn above a light-blue underline, shown between the number 1 and the words "Head of an Ox".
Evolution of the letter alef: the ancient ox-head pictograph on a blue line, an arrow to an older rotated, simplified ox-head form, and an arrow to a large light-blue capital Latin letter A.

keywords: first letter of the Hebrew alphabet
